description: Writes edited modeling model data back to the source that IModelingModelProvider loaded it from (Fáze 14, decision MODELING-INSPECTOR-EDITING). The provider contract stays READ-ONLY: a host that wants an editable inspector registers a separate writer resolved by ProviderKey. Capabilities is a default interface member so a 2.10.0 writer keeps working as Content only (decision MODELING-WRITER-CAPABILITIES).
